g.text: Real-data resources: actual model size and charged work
P counts the full network including learned adapters and full public heads. Feature/optimizer/checkpoint storage remains in plotted-data JSON. Training wall
includes actual concurrent conditions: do not interpret these bars as exclusive-throughput rankings. MAC proxies exclude backward/optimizer/nonlinearities.
